notes: «جميعا عن العلاء» joins the first two branches, so the tail is shared (rule 3); «- يعني الدراوردي -» is a gloss and is left out; the variant remark «بمثل حديث إسماعيل بن جعفر» names another transmitter for the same saying (rule 4), and no route is written beyond him, so none is added; Malik's wording is left out.
